identity_boundary: Do Phi Khanh, listed by OFAC as DO, Phi Khanh and referenced by Treasury as Do, is the person Treasury reported as an associate and proxy of DPRK nuclear-procurement facilitator Kim Se Un. Treasury's qualified conduct assessment and administrative-designation posture govern this record; criminal guilt, present location, current control of a bank account, and identity with a same-named public account remain unestablished.
